summary: Two live infrastructure issues reported, diagnosed, and hardened: (1) macro-indicators service was not running — restarted with `docker-compose up -d macro-indicators`; (2) socat bridge :4000→:3000 was hand-managed (PID 1551, unmanaged, would die on reboot) — replaced with launchd plist (com.vn-market.socat-bridge, KeepAlive=true) for persistent reboot recovery.

incident_1.root_cause: Container not running (absent from docker-compose ps output)
incident_1.impact: TNB Layer 2/3 macro stack (US PMI/Fed/US10Y/DXY + VN CPI/FX-reserves) restored. Regime extraction + cycle-bootstrap now have live macro data.

incident_2.root_cause: Hand-started socat (PID 1551) not supervised by launchd — dies on Mac reboot, reopens multi-day VPS outage
incident_2.caveat: Both endpoints return source_tier:2 (database-served from prior fetches) — this is EXPECTED and NORMAL. Tier-1 live VPS sources are scheduled separately (e.g. vpsProxyWatchdog every 10 min). The snapshot endpoints serve cached values, not live updates.
incident_2.persistence_mechanism: launchd RunAtLoad=true + KeepAlive=true ensures service survives reboot and crashes automatically

dashboard_reconcile: Tier-1 recovery complete. Audit signals: cow-MACRO-DOWN→RESOLVED (macro-indicators now UP); VPS-SOCAT-PERSIST→HARDENED (launchd supervision in place, survives reboot). No remaining CRITICAL infra items tied to these incidents.
